text: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the bank holding company that owns and controls JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.

source.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: JPMorganChase’s principal bank subsidiary is JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association (“JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.”)
